concerns.text: T006 expects '4 × 2 × N_processed rows' (baseline included), T007/T008 aggregate a baseline condition, but every contract's `transformation` enum permits only box_cox/yeo_johnson/rank_based. Baseline rows cannot be written to any conforming artifact; either the contracts gain a `baseline` value or the tasks drop baseline — as written the deliverables violate the data contracts they cite.

Plan T021 (the primary FR-004 estimator) mandates N=5000 label shuffles per dataset; T006 specifies 1000. The task silently relaxes the plan's stated iteration count, which directly governs SC-002/SC-004 precision. Align to 5000 or document the change in the plan.

Plan T023 mandates 10,000 bootstrap resamples; T008 specifies '≥ 2000, fixed seed = 123'. Since SC-004's ±0.02 half-width target depends on resample count, the task weakens the plan's precision guarantee without documentation.

Plan T024 runs the Friedman test on 'per-dataset error/power outcomes'; T009 performs it only on error rates ('separately for t-test and ANOVA'). The power-side Friedman analysis required by the plan has no implementing task — a dropped acceptance element of FR-008's plan mapping.

US-4 scenario 3 requires power bootstrap CIs to be 'validated against the ±0.02 half-width target'. T007's JSON records ci_lower/ci_upper but no half-width computation or validation step, and T008's SC-004 check covers only aggregated results, not per-combination power CIs. The acceptance criterion does not survive into any task's verification.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs spec.md:US-1 Independent Test / SC-001
concerns.text: US-1's independent test requires 'at least 50 datasets meet the filtering criteria' (post-filter), and SC-001 measures 'count ≥50' against US-1 acceptance criteria. T002 only raises if <50 are downloaded; no task guarantees ≥50 retained after T003's exclusions. The stricter spec interpretation is silently narrowed to the download count.

Plan states log-shift interventions are logged to data/imputation_log.csv; T004 records them in results/transformations_log.csv / intervention_log field. Spec edge case only requires the intervention be 'logged with variable name and reason', so this is a documentation inconsistency, not a spec violation — pick one location and align plan/tasks.
